name: The Whispering Teapot Mire
core_rationale: Western overflow marsh at grid [0, 1] where cracked porcelain aqueducts spilled warm mineral water into a silver-mist reed fen, reserved as an intentional Fog of Lore frontier on the edge of Teacup Meadows.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: The Lantern-Keepers say a giant sunken sugar-bowl lies half-submerged in the western reeds, guarded by sleepy steam-frogs.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A broken porcelain bridge vanishing into thick silver steam-fog and giant cattails.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Why did the western sluice-gate seal itself during the Great Lantern Eclipse?
mystery_hook.discovery_trigger_hint: Lifts when players clear the Under-Hearth Kiln Cellar and restore pressure to the western sluice.

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors the western [0, 1] fog_of_lore boundary portal of town-lantern-hollow in district-teacup-meadows.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Silver steam-fog marsh concealing a giant sunken porcelain sugar-bowl.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Intentional mystery: cattail reed height caps and lily-pad stepping stones for 1.05m characters will be authored when promoted to draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Intentional mystery: sealed behind portal-lantern-hollow-west-fog (gate_state: fog_of_lore).

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, and unanswered_question without compiling a fake filler map.
